entries.title: Psalms 49:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,

entries.title: Psalms 49:2
segments: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.

entries.title: Psalms 49:3
segments: My mouth shall speak wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 49:4
segments: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

entries.title: Psalms 49:5
segments: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?

entries.title: Psalms 49:6
segments: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

entries.title: Psalms 49:7
segments: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him;

entries.title: Psalms 49:8
segments: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever;)

entries.title: Psalms 49:9
segments: That he should still live alway, That he should not see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 49:10
segments: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.

entries.title: Psalms 49:11
segments: Their inward thought is, [that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [And] their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.

entries.title: Psalms 49:12
segments: But man [being] in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.

entries.title: Psalms 49:13
segments: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 49:14
segments: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume, That there be no habitation for it.

entries.title: Psalms 49:15
segments: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 49:16
segments: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased.

entries.title: Psalms 49:17
segments: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.

entries.title: Psalms 49:18
segments: Though while he lived he blessed his soul (And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself,)

entries.title: Psalms 49:19
segments: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light.

entries.title: Psalms 49:20
segments: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not, Is like the beasts that perish.
